currentAffairs.point: The Gokul Dairy cooperative’s mandate was overturned by the court.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This decision highlights potential challenges to cooperative structures within India's agricultural sector and raises questions about government intervention in such bodies.

currentAffairs.point: The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) has postponed the implementation date for Unified Payment Interface (UPI) Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) rollout.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This delay reflects ongoing discussions and potential adjustments to digital payment policies within India.

currentAffairs.point: India has approved a ₹62,370-crore rabi fertiliser subsidy, representing a 64% increase over the budget estimate.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This reflects government policy aimed at supporting farmers and ensuring adequate crop production.

currentAffairs.point: Researchers analyzed microbial communities present on high-touch surfaces within the Chennai Metro Rail system.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: The study highlights a potential area for further investigation into urban microbiomes and their characteristics.

currentAffairs.point: The CEC suggests a three-year roadmap to phase out unsustainable sand mining from active river channels due to its disruptive effects on river systems.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This reflects growing concerns about the ecological damage caused by unregulated resource extraction and necessitates understanding of environmental regulations and conservation strategies.

currentAffairs.point: Moody’s has upgraded India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 7% based on robust consumption and investment dynamics.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This reflects a positive assessment of the Indian economy's trajectory by an international credit rating agency.

currentAffairs.point: Finmin has defined 'abnormally low bid' as more than 30% below estimated cost to ensure rationalization of government contracts.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This clarifies the criteria for evaluating bids and potentially preventing corruption or inefficient spending within public procurement.

currentAffairs.point: A Gorakhpur-bound train derailed in Kanpur due to an unknown cause.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: The incident highlights railway safety concerns and necessitates investigation into the circumstances surrounding the derailment.

currentAffairs.point: The government has decided to consistently exclude the creamy layer from OBC reservation benefits.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This decision addresses ongoing legal challenges and aims for greater equity within the reservation framework.

currentAffairs.point: Several industry bodies are seeking reductions in Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) and Securities Transaction Tax (STT) as part of pre-Budget consultations.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This highlights the ongoing dialogue between government and key sectors regarding fiscal policy and investment incentives.

currentAffairs.point: Overall tax mop-up rose by 12% during April-November.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: The jump of 50% in STT collections indicates a specific sector experiencing growth and highlights the government’s revenue targets.

currentAffairs.point: A new study reveals income inequality and geographical location significantly impact pain levels in adults.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This provides valuable data on the complex relationship between socioeconomic factors and healthcare access/outcomes – a frequently tested topic.

currentAffairs.point: The Justice Kurian Joseph Committee was established to examine issues related to the Centre-State relationship and its effectiveness.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This suggests an ongoing debate about the balance of power within India’s federal structure.

currentAffairs.point: At least two people have died and many are feared trapped after a building collapsed in New York City.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: The collapse highlights vulnerabilities in urban construction standards and necessitates an immediate assessment of safety regulations.

currentAffairs.point: Growers in Pampore report an increased saffron yield this season following erratic weather conditions last year.
currentAffairs.whyInNews: This reflects the vulnerability of specific agricultural products to climate change and highlights potential strategies for resilience.

history.point: Silvio Berlusconi tenders his resignation as Prime Minister of Italy, effective November 16, due in large part to the Euro area crisis.
A blast in Iran's Shahid Modarres missile base leads to the death of 17 of the Revolutionary Guards members, including Hassan Tehrani Moghaddam, a key figure in Iran's missile program.
Shanghai Transrapid sets a new world speed record of 501 kilometres per hour (311 mph) for commercial railway systems, which remains the fastest for unmodified commercial rail vehicles.
War in Afghanistan: Taliban forces abandon Kabul, ahead of advancing Afghan Northern Alliance troops.
Crown Prince Akihito is formally installed as Emperor Akihito of Japan, becoming the 125th Japanese monarch.
Tim Berners-Lee publishes a formal proposal for the World Wide Web.
USSR: Yuri Andropov becomes the General Secretary of the Communist Party's Central Committee, succeeding Leonid I. Brezhnev.
The Comoros joins the United Nations.
Vietnam War: As part of Vietnamization, U.S. President Richard Nixon sets February 1, 1972 as the deadline for the removal of another 45,000 American troops from Vietnam.
World War II: Naval Battle of Guadalcanal between Japanese and American forces begins near Guadalcanal. The battle lasts for three days and ends with an American victory.

USDA estimates a decrease in global cotton production due to reduced yields in the US, India, and Turkey.
Authorities are emphasizing strict enforcement of the cracker ban across all levels of government.
The African National Congress (ANC) achieved its weakest-ever local election result due to widespread corruption and joblessness.
Major private sector investments are being made in Navi Mumbai’s hospitality sector.
